title: Ma Rainey's brother and a stomping trombonist
summary: They talk about Ma Rainey's brother possibly being in town and about a man who stomped while talking.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: All that. Say, do you know Ma Rainey's brother?

I saw him, but I never did. No, I saw him. He was a good, real good wine here. Yeah. Are they supposed to have... My brother here is around town. I heard. I don't know. Yeah, this town? Maybe so. Maybe so.
I think he's still about good to talk with him.

Yeah, who could find him? Who's that tippin' trombone player? You know he used to tip when he walked? You told me about him one time and couldn't think of his name. I thought maybe he'd come to you today.

Yeah, but I don't know who he is. The only fella I used to know used to do funny things was horse over the river there. He'd stand up and stomp all the time. We call them horse. He always stomp when he'd be talking with you. Always would do that.
Do that for me. Show me how he did it.

I mean, I mean, this guy would be stand up talking like this and say, Yeah, man, you know. Like that all the time he'd do that. I said, man, what's the matter, please? No, man. See, I just, I can't have that. I didn't do that. But I don't see him do it the last time I saw him a couple of times.
